notes:
I couldn't write these notes. I made one search attempt, for the Enduring Word commentary on Jeremiah 50. My code failed while reading the results, and then the tool said I had no searches left for this turn. So I didn't open a single page on any of your approved sites.

Your rules say to report only what the pages actually say, with a URL for every point. With no pages read, anything I wrote would come from my own memory, so I've left every verse blank rather than guess.

If you ask again in a new message, I'll have the search tool back. This is the order I'd work through it:

1. **Traditional reading:** Enduring Word on Jeremiah 50; Bible Hub's verse pages (Gill, Ellicott, Pulpit, Barnes, Keil & Delitzsch); StudyLight; Precept Austin.
2. **Protestant differences:** Wesley's notes (wesley.nnu.edu); Spurgeon's sermons on v. 20, which he preached on more than once; Ligonier, Desiring God, The Gospel Coalition and Monergism on vv. 5 and 20 (the everlasting covenant and forgiveness of the remnant); LCMS and 1517 on v. 20.
3. **Other views:** NET Bible notes, especially on Bel and Marduk (v. 2), the "nation from the north" (vv. 3 and 9) and the place names Merathaim and Pekod (v. 21); Bible Odyssey; New Advent (the Church Fathers and the Catholic Encyclopedia articles on Babylon and Bel); Catholic.com; OCA.

If it helps, I can do it in smaller batches, such as vv. 1–10 first and then vv. 11–23. That way one failed search won't hold up the whole set.
